risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risks on its revolving credit facilities and term loans. A 100 basis point increase in rates would result in approximately $2.8 million in additional annual expenses (on the revolving facility) plus $14.1 million (on the term loan), for a total impact of approximately $17 million.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Foreign exchange risk is high due to the company's operations in multiple countries with exposure to the euro, Czech koruna, Chinese yuan, Indian rupee, and other currencies. A 10% appreciation of the US dollar against the euro would result in approximately a $14.3 million decrease in operating revenue.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is low to moderate due to the company's exposure to its customer base (over 10,000 global customers) but mitigated by risk management programs and established long-term relationships with leading multinational customers.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on significant information systems for its global operations, but specific risks are not detailed in the report. Risk management measures are in place.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory risk is moderate due to the company's exposure to environmental, safety, and commercial regulations in the countries where it operates. The company has compliance programs in place to mitigate these risks.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Reputational risk is moderate due to the importance of the company's reputation for its customer relationships and market position. Reputational damage could have consequences on business operations.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical risk is high due to the company's global operations (United States, Asia, Australia, India, Europe, South America) and exposure to trade tensions and geopolitical tensions, particularly regarding clean energy technologies.
